extraction.Name: Susan Estes, formerly Susan Utterback
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband and I farm and raise stock.
extraction.NOTES: Six dependents; not in good health; does not remember making an application for patent; got patent from the Blackpipe Farmer but does not remember the date; received $4000.00 for land; cash deal; satisfied with the sale; subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, May 14, 1929; commission expires 4-28-32
